Query each range unfiltered and with repository plus policy filters

checks.evidence: Six filtered and unfiltered apply queries were byte-identical after normalizing only generated_at.
reproduction_steps: Seed 170 signed observations through POST /internal/apply-observability in both runtimes
Query each range unfiltered and repository-filtered

checks.contract_clause: Storage reads are bounded by the requested window
checks.evidence: 6h storage rows fell from 2,120 to 120 for automerge and from 169 to 2 for apply; 24h and 7d counts scaled with their windows.
reproduction_steps: Run both StatusStore revisions through the proof-only counting storage adapter
Record rows returned by list() and get()

checks.contract_clause: UTC day-boundary replay is counted once
checks.evidence: The same signed observation at 00:00:00Z was ingested twice and the candidate response remained byte-identical to merge-base's one logical per-run record.
reproduction_steps: Create one apply observation exactly at UTC midnight
POST it twice through the signed internal route
